sentences.text:
Smt. Nagma @ Nagma Haroon vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on
15 February, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:25396
Court No. - 90
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 45359 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Nagma @ Nagma Haroon

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Syed Wajid Ali,Santosh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the impugned cognizance order dated 05.03.2020 in Case Crime No. 537 of 2018, under Sections 506,
323, 498A, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Fatehganj (West) District Bareilly, order dated 13.03.2023 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Room-5 in Case No. 2219 of 2021 (State Vs. Haroon and others) and order dated 19.08.2023 passed by Additional and Sessions Judge,
Room No. 8, Bareilly in Criminal Revision No. 179 of 2023 (Smt. Nagma Vs. Zesheen and others).
It is further prayed that learned Magistrate may kindly be directed to pass fresh cognizance order.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the informant and the charge sheet has been filed against some of the accused person although against the main accused Zishan, Jakir and Safi Uddin no summoning order has been passed.

Learned counsel for the Smt. Nagma @ Nagma Haroon vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108076230/
1 applicant further submits that the revision was filed which was initially allowed.

entities.text: Smt. Nagma @ Nagma Haroon vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However in the second round Magistrate has passed the same order against which the revision has been rejected.
Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the aforesaid accused persons ought to have been summoned by the court concerned.
4. On a pointed query being made to learned counsel for the applicant as to why the applicant cannot press for summoning of the remaining accused persons at the stage of Section 319 Cr.P.C.,

counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant may be permitted to withdraw the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with liberty to move appropriate proceedings under Section 319 Cr.P.C. before the court concerned.
5. In the event any such application is filed, then the same would be considered by the court concerned in accordance with law in a time bound manner.
6. Accordingly, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.

Order Date :- 15.2.2024 VMA  Smt. Nagma @ Nagma Haroon vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108076230/
